name: PlanHub
purpose: Highest-volume lead source. Pushes ITB notifications and bid-deadline reminders by email; project detail, GC identity and plan files sit behind the paid tier.

auth.notes: Portal login is manual at planhub.com. No public API for subcontractor accounts.

writes: bid intention (Bidding / Not Bidding) - manual click only

known_limits: GC/owner contact is hidden on the free tier - projects land against the 'PlanHub - GC Not Disclosed' placeholder client and must be re-pointed after preview.
Notification volume is high and untargeted; pad-ready new construction with no demolition scope is the dominant false positive.
Reminder emails ('only N days left') are not new invitations - dedupe against existing projects by name.
owner_action_required: Decide whether a paid PlanHub tier is worth it - it would unlock GC contact + plan files and remove the placeholder-client step.
